$comment: A workflow with a human approval in the middle. qa verifies, an operator approves, and only then does the reviewer sign off. Compile: baton workflow compile <this> --run <key> --input 'branch and sha to verify'. Approve with: baton tasks approve <key of the approval task>.
name: Release approval
description: Verify a branch, get a human go-ahead, then a final review. Proves approval nodes, deadlines and affinity in Baton.

data.label: Verify the candidate
data.instructions: Check out the branch named in the workflow input, run the project's test command, and register a test_report with suite, passed and failed counts and the commit sha. Do not modify source files.

data.label: Operator go/no-go
data.instructions: A person decides whether the candidate may be released, based on the test report.

data.label: Final review
data.instructions: Read the test_report and the approval review. Write a short release review: verdict approve, summary of what was verified and who approved, no findings unless something is wrong.
